568: static void vs_handle_app_event(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime,
569:                                 struct vs_network_s *network,
570:                                 const struct vs_app_event_s *event)
571: {
572:   if (event->type < VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY &&
573:       (event->request_id == 0 ||
574:        event->request_id != runtime->active_request_id))
575:     {
576:       return;
577:     }
578: 
579:   switch (event->type)
580:     {
581:       case VS_APP_EVENT_PHOTO_READY:
582:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_PHOTO_CAPTURE)
583:           {
584:             if (event->text[0] == '\0')
585:               {
586:                 vs_cancel_request(runtime);
587:                 vs_set_error(runtime, -EBADMSG, VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK, false);
588:               }
589:             else
590:               runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING;
591:           }
592:         break;
593: 
594:       case VS_APP_EVENT_PHOTO_FAILED:
595:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_PHOTO_CAPTURE)
596:           {
597:             vs_cancel_request(runtime);
598:             vs_set_error(runtime, event->error, VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK, false);
599:           }
600:         break;
601: 
602:       case VS_APP_EVENT_VOICE_REPLY:
603:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_THINKING)
604:           {
605:             if (event->text[0] == '\0')
606:               {
607:                 vs_cancel_request(runtime);
608:                 vs_set_error(runtime, -EBADMSG,
609:                              runtime->photo_context ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
610:                                                       VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false);
611:               }
612:             else
613:               {
614:                 snprintf(runtime->result_text, sizeof(runtime->result_text),
615:                          "%s", event->text);
616:                 runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_SPEAKING;
617:               }
618:           }
619:         break;
620: 
621:       case VS_APP_EVENT_VOICE_FAILED:
622:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING ||
623:             runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_THINKING)
624:           {
625:             vs_cancel_request(runtime);
626:             vs_set_error(runtime, event->error,
627:                          runtime->photo_context ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
628:                                                   VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false);
629:           }
630:         break;
631: 
632:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_STARTED:
633:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_STARTING)
634:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
635:         break;
636: 
637:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_START_FAILED:
638:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_STARTING)
639:           {
640:             vs_cancel_request(runtime);
641:             vs_set_error(runtime, event->error, VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false);
642:           }
643:         break;
644: 
645:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_ALERT:
646:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING ||
647:             runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT)
648:           {
649:             runtime->emotion = event->emotion;
650:             runtime->emotion_color = event->color;
651:             snprintf(runtime->alert_text, sizeof(runtime->alert_text), "%s",
652:                      event->text);
653:             runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT;
654:           }
655:         break;
656: 
657:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_ALERT_CLEARED:
658:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT ||
659:             runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED)
660:           {
661:             runtime->emotion = VS_EMOTION_NONE;
662:             runtime->emotion_color = 0;
663:             runtime->alert_text[0] = '\0';
664:             if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT)
665:               runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
666:           }
667:         break;
668: 
669:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_PAUSED:
670:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSING)
671:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED;
672:         break;
673: 
674:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_RESUMED:
675:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESUMING)
676:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
677:         break;
678: 
679:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_PAUSE_FAILED:
680:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSING ||
681:             runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESUMING)
682:           vs_set_error(runtime, event->error, VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING, false);
683:         break;
684: 
685:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_RESULT:
686:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_FINALIZING)
687:           {
688:             if (event->text[0] == '\0')
689:               {
690:                 vs_cancel_request(runtime);
691:                 vs_set_error(runtime, -EBADMSG, VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false);
692:               }
693:             else
694:               {
695:                 snprintf(runtime->result_text, sizeof(runtime->result_text),
696:                          "%s", event->text);
697:                 runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESULT;
698:               }
699:           }
700:         break;
701: 
702:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED:
703:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_FINALIZING)
704:           {
705:             vs_cancel_request(runtime);
706:             vs_set_error(runtime, event->error, VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false);
707:           }
708:         break;
709: 
710:       case VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY:
711:         runtime->network_busy = false;
712:         if (network != NULL)
713:           (void)vs_network_get_status(network, &runtime->network);
714:         runtime->error = 0;
715:         runtime->error_retryable = false;
716:         runtime->page = runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP ? VS_PAGE_SOFTAP :
717:                         runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
718:                                                  VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
719:         runtime->progress = 0;
720:         break;
721: 
722:       case VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_FAILED:
723:         runtime->network_busy = false;
724:         if (network != NULL)
725:           (void)vs_network_get_status(network, &runtime->network);
726:         runtime->error_target_mode = runtime->network_target_mode;
727:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_PREPARING &&
728:             runtime->network_target_mode == VS_NET_STA)
729:           {
730:             /* History browsing and the photo entry remain useful offline.
731:              * Keep the failure for a later explicit network operation instead
732:              * of replacing the first product page with a fatal error. */
733: 
734:             runtime->error = event->error;
735:             runtime->error_retryable = network != NULL;
736:             runtime->page = runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
737:                                                      VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
738:             printf("velasight: initial STA unavailable (%d), continuing "
739:                    "offline\n", event->error);
740:           }
741:         else
742:           {
743:             vs_set_error(runtime, event->error,
744:                          runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP ? VS_PAGE_SOFTAP :
745:                          runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
746:                                                   VS_PAGE_HISTORY,
747:                          network != NULL);
748:           }
749:         break;
750:     }
751: }
